agentProfiles.name: Supervisor
agentProfiles.notes: The only seat the user talks to. Open it and just describe the goal — the Supervisor role is its system prompt, no /supervisor needed. Pins down intent, launches Lead agents, keeps Leads and Peers on course on a heartbeat, and brings decisions back to the user. Never implements. Do not launch it from another agent.

agentProfiles.name: Lead
agentProfiles.notes: Launched by the Supervisor only. Owns one project's technical outcome: plans, dispatches Peer profiles, debates their challenges, reviews, and accepts or rejects candidates. Never implements; never launches another Lead.

agentProfiles.name: Cheap peer
agentProfiles.notes: Launched by a Lead. Extraction, classification, summaries of supplied text, formatting, log triage, renames, doc/comment updates, mechanical refactors, test scaffolding.

agentProfiles.name: Peer
agentProfiles.notes: Launched by a Lead. DEFAULT for implementation, debugging, multi-file refactors, research with judgement, writing.

agentProfiles.name: Expensive peer
agentProfiles.notes: Launched by a Lead. Hard problems only: architecture decisions, cross-module refactors with invariants, subtle concurrency/data bugs, tasks where a Peer retry already failed. Chosen by the Lead's tier routing or escalation, never as a default.

agentProfiles.name: Review peer
agentProfiles.notes:
Launched by a Lead. Read-only Peer on the claude-reviewer provider: its runtime sets Edit/web/credential denies and a no-network Bash sandbox, but each guarantee counts only after `slp-reviewer-check` passes it (until then: unverified). Its brief still says read-only. Independent review of an exact candidate against its acceptance evidence, architecture questions, committee member.
Never edits files.

agentProfiles.name: Codex peer
agentProfiles.notes: Launched by a Lead. Writable Peer from another model family: used when the instruction asks for Codex, or to retry a task a Claude Peer already failed. Not a rung on the tier ladder.

agentProfiles.name: Codex review peer
agentProfiles.notes:
Launched by a Lead. Read-only Peer from another model family on the codex-reviewer provider: launcher sets sandbox_mode=read-only, approval_policy=never, no network, but each guarantee counts only after `slp-reviewer-check` passes it (until then: unverified); Paseo's modeId-to-flag mapping is not probed. Its brief still says read-only. Cross-family review of Claude-written candidates, plan review, committee member, debate tie-breaker.
Never edits files.

claude-supervisor.label: Claude Supervisor
claude-supervisor.description: Supervisor seat — its own Claude runtime whose output style carries the room protocol and Supervisor role; full Paseo tools to launch and watch Leads

claude-lead.label: Claude Lead
claude-lead.description: Lead seat — its own Claude runtime whose output style carries the room protocol and Lead role; launches Peers only

claude-peer.label: Claude Peer
claude-peer.description: Peer seat — its own Claude runtime whose output style carries the room protocol and Peer role; can message its Lead (send_agent_prompt) but cannot spawn or control agents

claude-reviewer.label: Claude Reviewer
claude-reviewer.description: Reviewer seat — the Peer runtime plus a Bash sandbox, Edit/web/credential denies and subprocess env scrubbing; whether they hold is reported by slp-reviewer-check

codex-peer.label: Codex Peer
codex-peer.description: Peer seat on Codex — the room protocol and Peer role are its developer instructions; can message its Lead (send_agent_prompt) but cannot spawn or control agents

codex-reviewer.label: Codex Reviewer
codex-reviewer.description: Reviewer seat on Codex — the Peer runtime in a read-only sandbox with approvals off; whether it holds is reported by slp-reviewer-check
